$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'
$toolRoot='C:\Users\gb\.codex\tmp\pvground_selected_mask_training_20261009\postrun_tools'
$reviewRoot=Join-Path $toolRoot 'source_review'
$localRoot=Split-Path -Parent $toolRoot
$spanReview='C:\Users\gb\.codex\tmp\pvground_extremal_span_evidence_20261009\runner_v1\source_review'
$otherReview=Join-Path $localRoot 'postrun_source_review_20261009'
if (Test-Path -LiteralPath (Join-Path $reviewRoot 'INPUT_MANIFEST_R2.json')) { throw 'Retention R2 manifest already exists; refuse overwrite' }
$priorFiles=@(@($reviewRoot,$spanReview,$otherReview) | ForEach-Object { Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $_ -File -Recurse } | Sort-Object FullName)
$copies=@{ 'RETENTION_SOURCE_REVIEW.md'='RETENTION_SOURCE_REVIEW_R1.md'; 'RETENTION_SOURCE_REVIEW.json'='RETENTION_SOURCE_REVIEW_R1.json'; 'RAW_RESPONSE.md'='RAW_RESPONSE_R1.md'; 'INPUT_MANIFEST.json'='INPUT_MANIFEST_R1.json' }
foreach ($sourceName in $copies.Keys) { $destination=Join-Path $reviewRoot $copies[$sourceName]; if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $destination) { throw 'Retention R1 version already exists; refuse overwrite' }; Copy-Item -LiteralPath (Join-Path $reviewRoot $sourceName) -Destination $destination }
$baseline=@($priorFiles | ForEach-Object { $preserved=$_.FullName; if ($_.FullName -eq (Join-Path $reviewRoot 'RETENTION_SOURCE_REVIEW.md')) { $preserved=Join-Path $reviewRoot 'RETENTION_SOURCE_REVIEW_R1.md' }; if ($_.FullName -eq (Join-Path $reviewRoot 'RETENTION_SOURCE_REVIEW.json')) { $preserved=Join-Path $reviewRoot 'RETENTION_SOURCE_REVIEW_R1.json' }; $digest=(Get-FileHash -LiteralPath $_.FullName -Algorithm SHA256).Hash.ToLowerInvariant(); if ((Get-FileHash -LiteralPath $preserved -Algorithm SHA256).Hash.ToLowerInvariant() -ne $digest) { throw 'Prior review preservation differs' }; [ordered]@{path=$_.FullName;preserved_path=$preserved;bytes=$_.Length;sha256=$digest} })
$baseline | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 10 | Set-Content -LiteralPath (Join-Path $reviewRoot 'R2_PRIOR_PRESERVATION_BASELINE.json') -Encoding UTF8
$old=Get-Content -LiteralPath (Join-Path $reviewRoot 'INPUT_MANIFEST_R1.json') -Raw -Encoding UTF8 | ConvertFrom-Json
$inputPaths=@($old | ForEach-Object { $_.path })
$inputPaths += Join-Path $toolRoot 'SOURCE_R2_REQUEST.txt'
$inputPaths += @('RETENTION_SOURCE_REVIEW_R1.md','RETENTION_SOURCE_REVIEW_R1.json','RAW_RESPONSE_R1.md','INPUT_MANIFEST_R1.json','STATIC_VERIFICATION.json') | ForEach-Object { Join-Path $reviewRoot $_ }
$spec=Get-Content -LiteralPath (Join-Path $localRoot 'pair_spec.json') -Raw -Encoding UTF8 | ConvertFrom-Json
$inputPaths += @($spec.new_runner_files.PSObject.Properties.Name | Sort-Object | ForEach-Object { Join-Path $localRoot $_ })
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path (Join-Path $reviewRoot 'r2_snapshots') | Out-Null
$index=0
$manifest=@($inputPaths | ForEach-Object { $index+=1; $item=Get-Item -LiteralPath $_; $snap='r2_snapshots\{0:D3}_{1}' -f $index,$item.Name; Copy-Item -LiteralPath $item.FullName -Destination (Join-Path $reviewRoot $snap); [ordered]@{path=$item.FullName;snapshot=$snap;bytes=$item.Length;sha256=(Get-FileHash -LiteralPath $item.FullName -Algorithm SHA256).Hash.ToLowerInvariant()} })
$manifest | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 10 | Set-Content -LiteralPath (Join-Path $reviewRoot 'INPUT_MANIFEST_R2.json') -Encoding UTF8
Copy-Item -LiteralPath (Join-Path $toolRoot 'SOURCE_R2_REQUEST.txt') -Destination (Join-Path $reviewRoot 'R2_EXACT_REQUEST.txt')
[ordered]@{prior_artifact_contents=$baseline.Count;versioned_R1_copies=$copies.Count;inputs=$manifest.Count;tool_hashes=@($manifest|Select-Object -First 3)} | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 10
